description: Trim leading 'the', possessive 's, quotes/brackets and trailing punctuation or (R)/TM from spaCy spans; offsets are adjusted to the trimmed name
examples: 'the NVIDIA Blackwell' -> 'NVIDIA Blackwell' | "CX Dive's" -> 'CX Dive' | 'The Biden-Harris' -> 'Biden-Harris' | 'The Federal Trade Commission' -> 'Federal Trade Commission'

description: Drop spaCy spans with non-Latin script, no letters, or mojibake markers (English-only NER model)
Drop a spaCy span whose cleaned text is already a lexicon alias (the lexicon match is authoritative)
Link a spaCy spelling variant (same case/space/punctuation-insensitive key) to the curated lexicon entity
Give one normalized spaCy name one type (ORG/PERSON/PRODUCT majority vote; tie: ORG > PRODUCT > PERSON)
Use the most frequent spelling as canonical name for one normalized spaCy name
Distinct spaCy-only entity IDs before/after type and spelling resolution
